hero.heading: Create your account and join the ritual.
hero.intro: Your access needs to be linked to a real account so your license, profile and progress stay safe on any device.

benefits.1: Access linked to your email — not just to this browser.
benefits.2: Persistent profile so you can come back to the game anytime.
benefits.3: Foundation for friends, history, dashboard and platform expansion.

card.title: Create account
card.subtitle: Use your details to access the SEXTOLUGAR platform securely.

bottom.1: By continuing, your account will be created in the game's official environment.
bottom.2: Your license will then be linked manually from the dashboard.

validation.shortUsername: Pick a username with at least 3 characters.
validation.shortPassword: Password must be at least 6 characters.

status.createdGoLogin: Account created. Sending you to sign-in...

errors.operationNotAllowed: Email/password sign-up is not enabled in Firebase.
errors.permissionDenied: Firestore refused to save the profile.
